import subprocess, pathlib
nu=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); port=['python','executable.py']
cmds=['1 + 2','1 + 2 * 3','(1 + 2) * 3','[1 2 3]','{a: 1 b: 2}','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}]','[1 2 3] | math sum','[1 2 3] | length','{a: 1, b: test} | to json','{a: 1} | to json --raw','\"a,b\\\\n1,2\" | from csv | to json','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}] | to csv','\"hello\" | str upcase','\"HELLO\" | str downcase','\" hello \" | str trim','\"abc\" | str contains b','\"abc\" | str replace b X','pwd','ls | length','open REFERENCE_BINARY.txt | str trim','[1 2 3] | first','[1 2 3] | last','[1 2 3] | get 1','[{a: 1} {a: 2}] | get a','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}] | select a','[{a: 1 b: 2} {a: 3 b: 4}] | where a > 1','[1 2 3] | each {|x| "'$x + 1 }'"','seq 1 3 | to json','3 < 4','true and false','not false','10 / 4','10 // 4','10 mod 4','2 ** 3','print hello','print 1 + 2','no-such-command']
fail=0
for c in cmds:
 r=subprocess.run([nu,'--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)
 p=subprocess.run(port+['--no-config-file','-c',c],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and (r.stderr==p.stderr or c=='no-such-command'))
 print(('OK ' if ok else 'BAD'), c)
 if not ok:
  fail+=1; print(' ref',r.returncode,repr(r.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:240])); print(' got',p.returncode,repr(p.stdout.decode('utf-8','replace')),repr(p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace')[:240]))
print('fail', fail)
'@ | python -; Get-ChildItem -Force executable*"
